newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shouguang Paper to issue 100 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Shouguang Paper to issue 100 mln B shares.

text.p: Shandong Shouguang Paper Industry Co Ltd has been given the approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 100 million B shares and list them in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The offer has been tentatively priced at HK$5-6 per share and Shouguang expects to list the shares by April next year, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

China Southern Securities has been appointed domestic lead underwriter for the offer, with Seapower Financial Services Group and Jardine Fleming International Inc international coordinators, the official said.
Shouguang aims to channel proceeds from the B share offer into its main business, making paper for writing and painting, he said.
Shouguang has forecast net profits of about 150 million yuan for 1996, compared with 83 million yuan in 1995 and 50 million yuan in 1994, he said.

After the B share offer, Shouguang's total share capital will rise to 240 million shares, including 100 million state shares, 21 million legal person shares, 19 million staff shares and 100 million B shares.
The company is based in Shouguang in eastern Shandong province. The official said that Shouguang Paper plans to change its name to Shandong Chengming Paper Industry Co Ltd.
